component.name: AfterLine
component.summary: Private, offline meeting recorder with transcripts and notes

description.p: AfterLine records your meetings from the whole computer or from a single application such as Firefox, Chrome, Zoom, Teams or Discord, with or without your microphone, then writes a timestamped transcript and clear meeting notes: a summary, decisions, action items and dates.
Everything happens on your computer. There is no account, no cloud service and no telemetry. Recordings are saved continuously, so a crash or power cut never costs you the meeting.

screenshot.caption: Meeting notes with decisions and action items, each linked to the moment it was said
Recording a call with a live transcript
My tasks: everything you promised, across all meetings

description.p: My tasks only lists real follow-ups (not plans described in a talk or steps done during the meeting), and tasks can be deleted. AfterLine tells you when a new version is out, and Settings has "Report a problem" and "Suggest an idea".
Call suggestions and alerts are desktop notifications with a Record button, the notes have a Copy button, and the live transcript can be switched off during a recording.
Transcripts no longer fill with a phrase repeated over and over, and the live transcript drops the call's echo from your microphone.
Rewritten as a native application: per-application recording, offline transcription and notes, meeting library and search.
